rationale: The Latin anchors *scopæ* (broom/bundle of twigs) and *virga* (rod/twig/stick) confirm that OE *besma* denotes a physical implement — a besom/broom made of bundled twigs or rods. The gospel context (Mt. 12:44 / Lk. 11:25: the house found swept with brooms, *scopis mundatam*) reinforces a long thin wooden implement used for sweeping, matching rod.n.01 ("a long thin implement made of metal or wood") as the closest WordNet analog.
